title: Bad Plastic
description: A customer fumbles the card number field entirely — too short, or full of letters. The mock gateway shouldn't be reached at all for a malformed card number.
successCondition: Create an invoice, then POST /api/billing/invoices/:id/pay with { "cardNumber": "123" } (too short) returns 400 with error.code VALIDATION_ERROR. The same call with { "cardNumber": "abcd1234abcd1234" } (non-numeric) also returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. Neither call creates a Payment record — GET /api/billing/invoices/:id/payments afterward returns an empty payments array.
hints: The card number field is validated as 13-19 digits per docs/api/billing.md, checked before the mock gateway logic ever runs.
Check the payments list after both bad attempts, not just after one, to confirm neither malformed request left a partial record.
